outputSchema.description: Optional. The schema of the output arguments of the MCP tool.

audioProcessingConfig.description: Optional. Audio processing configuration of the app.

description.description: Optional. Human-readable description of the app.

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the app was last updated.

evaluationMetricsThresholds.description: Optional. The evaluation thresholds for the app.

variableDeclarations.description: Optional. The declarations of the variables.

timeZoneSettings.description: Optional. TimeZone settings of the app.

globalInstruction.description: Optional. Instructions for all the agents in the app. You can use this instruction to set up a stable identity or personality across all the agents.

languageSettings.description: Optional. Language settings of the app.

validationErrors.description: Output only. Misconfigurations or warnings in the app.

transferRules.description: Optional. Agent transfer rules. If multiple rules match, the first one in the list will be used.

childAgents.description: Optional. List of child agents in the agent tree. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/agents/{agent}`

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the agent was last updated.

generatedSummary.description: Output only. If the agent is generated by the LLM assistant, this field contains a descriptive summary of the generation.

validationErrors.description: Output only. Misconfigurations or errors in the agent that may affect agent quality.

The provided callbacks are executed sequentially in the exact order they are given in the list. If a callback returns an overridden response, execution stops and any remaining callbacks are skipped.
